user.title: Sign in to Frigidaire
user.description: Choose how you sign in to the Frigidaire app. If you sign in with Google or Apple, use an API key. The method cannot be changed later without deleting the entry and adding it again.

menu_options.api_key: API key (beta), required for Google or Apple sign-in

api_key.title: API key (beta)
api_key.description:
Sign in to the [Electrolux developer portal]({portal_url}) with your Frigidaire account, including Google or Apple sign-in, and create an API key. Copy three values from the portal: the API key, the access token and the refresh token.

The refresh token works only once: Home Assistant replaces it as it goes, so do not use the same tokens in another Home Assistant or a script, or each will sign the other out. This sign-in method is in beta.

data_description.api_key: The API key shown on the developer portal dashboard.
data_description.access_token: The access token generated with the API key.
data_description.refresh_token: The refresh token generated with the access token. It works only once.

device.title: Extra Controls — {device_name}
device.description: Select which entities to expose for {device_name}. Only enable options your device supports — unsupported settings will be silently ignored by the appliance.

data.heat_supported: Enable heat mode (confirmed heat-capable device only)

data_description.check_filter: Problem sensor that turns on when the filter state is CLEAN, CHANGE, or BUY. Use it to trigger filter-maintenance notifications.
data_description.bucket_status: Shows Full when the water bucket needs emptying and Empty otherwise. Dehumidifiers only — models that report no bucket signal show as unavailable.
data_description.filter_runtime: Cumulative air-filter runtime reported by the appliance in native seconds. Home Assistant converts it to the configured display unit.
data_description.heat_supported: Explicit opt-in for this appliance only. This does not detect heating capability; enable only after confirming the device supports heat. Temperature limits are unchanged.
data_description.compressor: Opt-in temperature-based estimate, not device telemetry. Adds a Compressor Estimate diagnostic sensor and refines hvac_action while enabled on appliances that do not report modeState.
data_description.cool_hysteresis: Temperature deadband around the setpoint used by the estimate. Zero disables the deadband.
data_description.compressor_off_delay: How long the room must remain below the lower deadband boundary before the estimate changes to idle.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Frigidaire
reauth_confirm.description:
Frigidaire no longer accepts the saved sign-in details for {username}. Enter the current ones for this entry's sign-in method: the password, or for an API key entry a new API key, access token and refresh token from the Electrolux developer portal.

The sign-in method cannot be changed here. To switch between email and password and an API key, delete this entry and add it again; entity history and per-appliance options do not carry over.
